item.title: A quicker first text from Murph
item.summary: When you start Murph by texting, simple first messages can now get a faster reply while the full assistant starts in the background.
item.details: Murph can answer a plain-text opener while the full assistant starts, and stays honest when personal context or an action needs the full runtime. Messages with attachments keep the complete attachment-aware path. Your next message continues with the first exchange in context.
